English.Char_Desc_450: PurgeCore is a complete, 100% free PC cleaner for Windows. It starts with disk space analysis (largest files and folders, storage breakdown by category), then adds duplicate detection, browser cleanup for Chrome/Edge/Firefox with a cookie whitelist, a startup program manager, a RAM check, and Temp/Recycle Bin cleanup. Every deletion goes to the Recycle Bin and shows a green/orange/red risk level before anything happens. No registry cleaner, no paid tier, no telemetry by default. A privacy-first alternative to CCleaner and similar tools.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
PurgeCore is a complete, 100% free PC cleaner for Windows, built around one idea: show people what's actually using their storage first, then let them clean it up safely.
The Dashboard gives a quick overview of drive usage and storage by category. The Explore section covers large files and folders, old files, and read-only driver info (with links to Windows Update and manufacturer sites, nothing downloaded automatically). The Cleanup section is where things actually change: a duplicate finder that matches files by content (not just name or size) and always keeps at least one copy, an empty folder finder, browser cleanup for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox (cache, cookies, history, with a cookie whitelist to stay signed in to chosen sites, bookmarks and passwords never touched), a Temp files and Recycle Bin cleaner, a RAM check that reports real before/after numbers instead of a promised gain, and a startup program manager that disables (reversibly) or removes items from Windows startup.
Every deletion in the app goes to the Recycle Bin, never permanent, and every deletable item shows a green/orange/red risk indicator plus a confirmation with the exact size before anything happens. There is deliberately no registry cleaner: on modern Windows it has little measurable benefit and a real risk of breaking something a program still needs.
PurgeCore has one tier: everything, free, forever. No premium upgrade, no ads inside the app, no telemetry unless explicitly opted in. The source code is public on GitHub. It's built as an alternative to CCleaner, BleachBit, and WinDirStat for people who want disk analysis and cleanup in one place without a registry cleaner or upsell prompts.
